about: What each result outside the charts was measured on: date, our builds (commit: what it covers, empty for everything), how our binary was built, the machines and the references. Read by eval/nceval/site.py (measured), which writes each page's caption from it; a page whose data has no entry fails python3 -m nceval.site --check.
